title: Shrinking to spread homotopies of fixed endomorphisms
statement:
Let Y,P,d,i,r,y,Q be as in the finite-free stalk chain-map lifting statement:
Y is a scheme [def-pc-scheme], P a cochain complex [def-pc-derived-category] of finite
free modules [def-weil-pbc-free-module] supported in [0,d], and Q=O_Y^r in degree i.
Fix an open V containing y. Let a,b be any two endomorphisms of P|V and c,e any two
endomorphisms of Q|V. Let S be termwise pullback [def-pc-derived-pullback] along
V.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyV. If S(a) is homotopic to S(b) and S(c) to S(e), then there
is an open W contained in V and containing y such that the restrictions of a,b to W
are homotopic and the restrictions of c,e to W are homotopic. Both pairs of maps are
fixed before shrinking; they need not be composites or identities.

source.place: Proof, first two paragraphs: local unit-entry cancellation and extension of the finite calculation; finite matrix homotopy identities after shrinking

proof.text: Apply the P-only shrinking statement to obtain U≤V containing y and a homotopy between the restrictions of a and b on U.
Apply the Q-inside shrinking statement with U to obtain W≤U containing y and a homotopy between the restrictions of c and e on W.

Apply the additive restriction functor from U to W to the P homotopy via Functor.mapHomotopy. Transport it through NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex of the restriction-composition comparison (restrictFunctorCongr of Scheme.homOfLE_homOfLE, followed by restrictFunctorComp). Naturality and the inverse identities identify the transported maps with the direct restrictions from V to W. Compose the inequalities W≤U≤V and combine the two homotopies. Both transport helpers are proved in the target module, with no holes.

proof_origin.place: Extension of the finite calculation, split into P shrinking and single-complex shrinking inside the resulting open; restriction transport proved using Mathlib functoriality and natural isomorphisms.

mathlib_searches.query: A homotopy between specified endomorphisms of bounded finite free complexes over a scheme stalk extends after shrinking an open neighbourhood
Homotopies between fixed endomorphisms of bounded finite free complexes spread from a stalk to a smaller open neighbourhood

from.place: Proof, extension of finite basis changes to a neighbourhood: extend homotopy coefficients and shrink for the two homotopy identities

theorem exists_shrink_homotopy_pair_of_stalk
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (P : CochainComplex Y.Modules ℤ) (d : ℕ)
    (hge : P.IsStrictlyGE 0) (hle : P.IsStrictlyLE d)
    (hfree : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ s : ℕ, Nonempty
      (P.X n ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin s))))
    (i : ℤ) (r : ℕ) (y : Y)
    (V : Y.Opens) (hyV : y ∈ V)
    (a b : (((restrictFunctor V.ι).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj P) ⟶
      (((restrictFunctor V.ι).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj P))
    (c e : (((restrictFunctor V.ι).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj
      ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor Y.Modules i).obj
      (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin r))))) ⟶
      (((restrictFunctor V.ι).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj
      ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor Y.Modules i).obj
      (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin r))))))
    (hP : Nonempty (Homotopy
      (((Modules.pullback (V.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyV)).mapHomologicalComplex _).map a)
      (((Modules.pullback (V.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyV)).mapHomologicalComplex _).map b)))
    (hQ : Nonempty (Homotopy
      (((Modules.pullback (V.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyV)).mapHomologicalComplex _).map c)
      (((Modules.pullback (V.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyV)).mapHomologicalComplex _).map e))) :
    ∃ (W : Y.Opens) (hWV : W ≤ V), y ∈ W ∧
      Nonempty (Homotopy
        (((restrictFunctor (Y.homOfLE hWV)).mapHomologicalComplex _).map a)
        (((restrictFunctor (Y.homOfLE hWV)).mapHomologicalComplex _).map b)) ∧
      Nonempty (Homotopy
        (((restrictFunctor (Y.homOfLE hWV)).mapHomologicalComplex _).map c)
        (((restrictFunctor (Y.homOfLE hWV)).mapHomologicalComplex _).map e))
